 Data Analyst Manager
 Position purpose 
 The Data analyst Manager will work on Data & Analytics initiatives to leverage on GSC, R&D & QA analytics to make sense of data — uncovering patterns, generating insights, measuring success and impact of analytics projects in relation to business KPIs.
The role requires a strong analytical and problem-solving background, with Supply Chain domain knowledge, having a strong business acumen. You should be familiar with the insight generation process, integrating and preparing large, varied datasets and analyzing the data to uncover insights and recommendations. You will be required to work with other business stakeholders, other data analysts and data strategists to define and develop data opportunities. In addition to advanced analytic skills, this role is also proficient at architecting specialized models / computing environments and communicating results in a narrated way.
 Position 
Work as a part of the Data and Analytics team to leverage on analytics to make sense of data — uncovering patterns, generating insights, measuring success and impact of analytics projects in relation to business KPIs
Maximize the value of actual data sources available and identify new data sources that could potentially add value for business processes optimization
Support GSC, R&D & QA functions by providing learnings and insights, knowledge sharing of how to best use the data assets, identifying gaps and pre-requisites in data sets to enable analytics use cases and translating business needs into specifications for report/ dashboards that enables business needs and good user experience
Closely collaborate with Data Strategists, Data Scientists and other Data Analysts to make sure the data collected is fully leveraged in each solution
 Requirements
Bachelor's Degree is advantageous (preferable in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Math, Engineering or a related field)
Fluent in English
Expertise (with relevant industry experience) in data analysis and insights generation in GSC, R&D or QA domain (or similar)
Ability to collect and organize data from different sources to solve a business question 
Competence in presenting findings to both business and technical stakeholders
Enthusiasm for challenging and interpreting data
Capacity to offer new perspectives for data analysis and storytelling
Skill in uncovering insights and driving practical business impact through storytelling
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with key stakeholders across functions
Ability to analyze data, identify and assess potential risks
Work autonomously while collaborating with cross-functional team
Experience at working with Power BI, SQL, major "big data" storage (i.e. Azure Data Lake) , nice to have SAP/SAP BW, Tableau
